items.source: Invokes buildFeedEntries(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) to get a list of feed entries.
items.translation: 调用buildFeedEntries(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)获取提要条目列表。

items.source: Application-specific view classes will extend this class. The view will be held in the subclass itself, not in a template. Main entry points are the AbstractFeedView.buildFeedMetadata(Map, T, HttpServletRequest) and buildFeedEntries(Map, Feed, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 特定于应用程序的视图类将扩展此类。视图将保存在子类本身中，而不是模板中。主要入口点是 AbstractFeedView.buildFeedMetadata(Map, T, HttpServletRequest) 和 buildFeedEntries(Map, Feed, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: Thanks to Jettro Coenradie and Sergio Bossa for the original feed view prototype!
items.translation: 感谢 Jettro Coenradie 和 Sergio Bossa 提供的原始 Feed 视图原型！

items.source: Defaults to Atom 1.0.
items.translation: 默认为 Atom 1.0。

items.source: By default returns an Atom 1.0 feed, but the subclass can specify any Feed.
items.translation: 默认返回 Atom 1.0 格式的源，但子类可以指定任何类型的源。

items.source:
Note that the passed-in HTTP response is just supposed to be used for
setting cookies or other HTTP headers. The built feed itself will automatically
get written to the response after this method returns.
items.translation: 注意，传入的 HTTP 响应仅用于设置 Cookie 或其他 HTTP 标头。内置的 Feed 将在本方法返回后自动写入响应中。

items.source: The default feed type used.
items.translation: 默认使用的馈送类型。
